university.name: University College London
university.summary: A London university with teaching based at Bloomsbury and, for management, Canary Wharf. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate taught degrees across computing, engineering, law, management and finance, and publishes Pakistan-specific graduate entry equivalences for 2027/28.

courses.title: Data Science
courses.duration_text: 1 calendar year full-time (2 calendar years part-time)
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in statistical science covering machine learning, statistical computing and statistical data science, with optional modules such as applied deep learning, and a research project.
highlights: Compulsory: Introduction to Statistical Data Science
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum of an upper second-class Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline, or an overseas equivalent. University-level linear algebra and mathematical methods are expected, with familiarity with probability and statistics, and prior experience in a high-level programming language such as R, MATLAB or Python.
courses.english_requirements: UCL English language Level 1. On the English language requirements page (published for September 2026 entry), IELTS Academic is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component, and PTE Academic is 75 overall with 67 in each communicative skill. Other accepted tests are listed on that page. Scores for 2027 entry are not yet confirmed on the course page, which gives the level only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: UCL's Pakistan graduate page for 2027/28 entry states: 2:1 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with an overall mark of 70% or CGPA of 3.3/4.0; 2:2 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with 60% or CGPA of 3.0/4.0 (5-year Laws and Architecture degrees on the same marks).
courses.application_deadline_note: Application deadline listed as to be confirmed on the course page.
courses.notes: Part-time fee on the page is GBP 24,300 per year. The 2027/28 course page lists the Year 1 compulsory list as indicative and shows up to 10 optional modules. The page does not name a Pakistan-specific route; Pakistan marks come from UCL's Pakistan graduate page.

courses.title: Management
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's at the UCL School of Management, based in Canary Wharf, covering financial frameworks, decision and risk analysis, statistics for business research and business research, with optional business modules.
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum of an upper second-class Bachelor's degree from a UK university, or an overseas equivalent, in any subject.
courses.english_requirements: UCL English language Level 2. On the English language requirements page (published for September 2026 entry), IELTS Academic is 7.0 overall with 6.5 in each component, and PTE Academic is 76 overall with 75 in each communicative skill. Other accepted tests are listed on that page. Scores for 2027 entry are not yet confirmed on the course page, which gives the level only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: UCL's Pakistan graduate page for 2027/28 entry states: 2:1 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with an overall mark of 70% or CGPA of 3.3/4.0; 2:2 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with 60% or CGPA of 3.0/4.0 (5-year Laws and Architecture degrees on the same marks).
courses.application_deadline_note: Application deadline listed as to be confirmed on the course page.
courses.notes: The page states the same GBP 44,400 figure for UK students. Module lists on the page are described as indicative.

courses.title: Financial Technology
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's combining blockchain, digital finance and machine learning in finance, with optional modules such as algorithmic trading and financial engineering, and a project.
highlights: Compulsory: Machine Learning with Applications in Finance
courses.academic_requirements: A minimum of an upper second-class UK Bachelor's degree, or an equivalent international qualification, in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, engineering or a similarly quantitative subject. Programming experience is an advantage but not mandatory.
courses.english_requirements: UCL English language Level 3. On the English language requirements page (published for September 2026 entry), IELTS Academic is 7.0 overall with 7.0 in each component, and PTE Academic is 76 overall with 76 in each communicative skill. Other accepted tests are listed on that page. Scores for 2027 entry are not yet confirmed on the course page, which gives the level only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: UCL's Pakistan graduate page for 2027/28 entry states: 2:1 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with an overall mark of 70% or CGPA of 3.3/4.0; 2:2 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with 60% or CGPA of 3.0/4.0 (5-year Laws and Architecture degrees on the same marks).
courses.application_deadline_note: Application deadline listed as to be confirmed on the course page. The page says no late applications will be considered.
courses.notes: The page states the same GBP 52,600 figure for UK students. Module lists on the page are described as indicative.

courses.title: Law
courses.duration_text: 10 months full-time (part-time over 2 academic years, flexible over up to 5 academic years)
courses.overview: A 10-month full-time Master of Laws in which students take optional law modules totalling 135 taught credits plus a 45-credit research essay. A law qualification is normally required.
highlights: Optional: Corporate Governance in the US and UK
Research Essay (45 credits, required for full-time study)
courses.academic_requirements: A good 2.1 with evidence of 1st class ability, normally an average of at least 65% across all years and at least one first-class mark, or an equivalent. A law qualification (LLB, JD or GDL) is required, with limited exceptions for graduates with at least five years of relevant work experience. Non-law graduates have separate criteria.
courses.english_requirements: UCL English language Level 4. On the English language requirements page (published for September 2026 entry), IELTS Academic is 7.5 overall with 7.0 in each component, and PTE Academic is 80 overall with 76 in each communicative skill. Other accepted tests are listed on that page. Scores for 2027 entry are not yet confirmed on the course page, which gives the level only.
courses.experience_requirements: Limited exceptions for graduates without a law qualification who have at least five years of relevant work experience.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: UCL's Pakistan graduate page for 2027/28 entry states: 2:1 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with an overall mark of 70% or CGPA of 3.3/4.0; 2:2 equivalent is a 4-year bachelor degree with 60% or CGPA of 3.0/4.0 (5-year Laws and Architecture degrees on the same marks).
courses.application_deadline_note: Application deadline listed as to be confirmed on the course page.
courses.notes: No compulsory modules are listed; the page shows up to 10 optional modules and notes the full range may be larger. The Pakistan 2:1 equivalence on UCL's Pakistan page is 70% or 3.3 CGPA, but this course asks for a good 2.1 with evidence of first class ability, so the course page wording governs. Part-time fee on the page is GBP 20,400 per year.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.overview: A three-year full-time degree in London whose first year covers computer science mathematics, algorithms and theory of computation, programming and software development, and programming language concepts.
highlights: Compulsory: Algorithms and Theory of Computation
courses.academic_requirements: A levels A*A*A, with A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics. IB: a total of 20 points in three higher level subjects including Grade 7 in Mathematics. A contextual offer of A*AB (A levels) or 38 points (IB) is listed.
courses.english_requirements: UCL English language Level 1. On the English language requirements page (published for September 2026 entry), IELTS Academic is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component, and PTE Academic is 75 overall with 67 in each communicative skill. Other accepted tests are listed on that page. Scores for 2027 entry are not yet confirmed on the course page, which gives the level only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: UCL's Pakistan page states that the Higher Secondary School Certificate is not suitable for direct entry to undergraduate programmes at UCL, that entrance requirements are based on three A Levels, and that the UCL University Preparatory Certificate (International Foundation Year) may suit HSSC holders. The page is not dated for a specific entry year.
courses.uk_min_alevels: A*A*A, with A* in Mathematics or Further Mathematics
courses.application_deadline_note: UCAS Equal Consideration deadline 13 January 2027, 6pm UK time. Applications may stay open after this date.
courses.notes: Year 1 optional modules were not found in the page text. The overall IB points figure for the standard offer was not captured, so only the higher level requirement is quoted.

courses.title: Mechanical Engineering
courses.duration_text: 3 academic years (4 with the Year in Industry option)
courses.overview: A three-year full-time engineering degree (UCAS H300) with an optional year in industry. Year 1 combines engineering challenges and modelling with mechanical engineering, thermofluids, dynamics and materials.
courses.academic_requirements: A levels A*AA, with Mathematics and Physics required and an A* in one of them. IB: 19 points across three Higher Level subjects, with 7 and 6 in Mathematics and Physics in either order and no Higher Level score below 5. A contextual offer of A*AB (A levels) or 18 points across three Higher Level subjects (IB) is listed. GCSE English Language and Mathematics at grade C or 4.
courses.english_requirements: UCL English language Level 1. On the English language requirements page (published for September 2026 entry), IELTS Academic is 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each component, and PTE Academic is 75 overall with 67 in each communicative skill. Other accepted tests are listed on that page. Scores for 2027 entry are not yet confirmed on the course page, which gives the level only.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: UCL's Pakistan page states that the Higher Secondary School Certificate is not suitable for direct entry to undergraduate programmes at UCL, that entrance requirements are based on three A Levels, and that the UCL University Preparatory Certificate (International Foundation Year) may suit HSSC holders. The page is not dated for a specific entry year.
courses.uk_min_alevels: A*AA including Mathematics and Physics, with A* in one of them
courses.application_deadline_note: UCAS Equal Consideration deadline 13 January 2027, 6pm UK time. Applications may stay open after this date.
courses.notes: The duration is four years with the Year in Industry option. The page also shows an unlabelled figure of 38 next to the contextual IB offer, which is unclear.
